proposed_rules.trigger: A node tagged [region] appears as a sibling far from its logical container (including near page root), with content matching an embed or FAQ answer elsewhere in the tree that lacks a matching child.
proposed_rules.decision: Re-associate the [region] node with its nearest matching placeholder by content adjacency and vertical position rather than treating it as separate/lost content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Confirms the pattern also seen in C171: absolutely/fixed-positioned descendants (here a bg:image embed, and an FAQ answer) are promoted to root by the capture tool, fragmenting single logical content items.
